# Tables

## Simple table

| Name   | Type   | Notes      |
| ------ | ------ | ---------- |
| apple  | fruit  | red        |
| carrot | vegetable | orange |

## Alignment

| Left | Center | Right |
| :--- | :----: | ----: |
| a    |   b    |     c |
| long value here | mid | 42 |

## Wide table (horizontal scroll case)

| Codec | Container | Lossless | HDR | 4K60 | Note |
| ----- | --------- | -------- | --- | ---- | ---- |
| avc | mp4 | no | yes | yes | baseline device support |
| hevc | mp4 | no | yes | yes | needs licensing note |
| av1 | mkv | no | yes | yes | slower to decode |

## Inline markup inside cells

| Item | Rendered |
| ---- | -------- |
| bold | **strong** |
| code | `x = 1` |
| link | [example](https://example.com) |
